newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan all-share Mibtel index touches new high.
newsitem.headline: Milan all-share Mibtel index touches new high.

text.p: The Milan bourse all-share Mibtel index touched a new record high of 13,714 on Monday morning before slipping back below 13,700.
Traders said trading was fairly thin and this therefore amplified price movements in what was a technical market.
The Mibtel's previous high of 13,700 was reached on July 2. At 1110 GMT, the Mibtel index was 0.65 percent higher at 13,697 while the Mib30 blue chip index was 0.56 percent up at 20,833.
The Mib30 index set a high of 20,913 on July 2.

Traders noted that the Italian stock market had a way to go yet before equalling historic highs of May 20, 1986 when the authoritative BCI (Comit) index reached 908.20. The BCI index, updated once a day, closed on Friday at 851.94.
